info.name: Pathway Analysis Service database report API
Downloads a report for a given pathway analysis result

params.name: token
params.description: The token associated with the data to query

params.name: species
params.description: The species for which results will be reported

params.name: filename
params.description: The name of the file to be downloaded

params.name: importableOnly
params.description: Filters resources to only includes importable ones

items.docs: This method provides a report for a given pathway analysis result in a PDF document. This document contains data about the analysis itself followed by the pathways overview and the most significant pathways overlaid with the analysis result. Users can download and store this information in a convenient format to be checked in the future when the 'token' is not longer available.
